observations: A single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The housing is black with a yellow section at the top.
The lens features a honeycomb-style grille pattern.
A watermark for 'HONDA AND Acura POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
The item is photographed against a rough, textured background.

claims.claim: Body,engine n suspension parts for all model of honda,acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: The photo shows only one headlight; no other parts or vehicle models are visible.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or aftermarket part rather than an original Toyota part.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or part number stamped on the housing.

risks.risk: The lens may be cracked or have internal fogging despite the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens surface without the plastic wrap.

risks.risk: The internal bulb or reflector may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior of the housing showing the bulb and reflector.

proof_requests: Photo of the part number or label stamped on the housing.
Photo of the lens without the plastic wrap to check for cracks.
Photo of the interior of the housing to confirm the bulb is present.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
